recover.map.title: Visit Physical Locations
recover.map.desc: When digital channels are slow or accounts are compromised, in-person escalation at your nearest bank branch or local Cyber Crime Cell guarantees a formal paper trail and official stamped acknowledgment.
recover.map.bank_rule_desc: Go in person to your nearest bank branch with your passbook, ID proof, and written application detailing the unauthorized transactions. Request a printed/stamped acknowledgment of your fraud complaint.
recover.map.police_rule_title: Police Station / Cyber Cell In-Person Protocol
recover.map.police_rule_desc: Go to your local police station or district Cyber Crime Cell. File a written First Information Report (FIR) or a non-cognizable (NC) report regarding the financial fraud. Keep a copy of the police complaint receipt, as banks often require it to process chargebacks or refunds.
